conventions.evidence: Most conventions followed: migrations have the generator boilerplate and reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_033521_create_entities_table.php:27-30, ..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:29-34); mass assignment declared via the sibling #[Fillable] attribute pattern (app/Models/Entity.php:13, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12); authorization lives in policies, not UI (app/Policies/*); docs kept in sync (docs/database-schema.md:141,150-152,160-161); CHANGELOG updated (CHANGELOG.md:29). Deviations: the project's mandatory TDD rule ('No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test') is ignored — no tests in the diff; and two unrelated CI files were added (.github/workflows/tests.yml, empty .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml).

security.evidence: All authorization is server-side and centralized in policies: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-40 (create any authenticated, view only members, update/delete owner+admin, manageSettings owner only) and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-38 (view member-only, assignRole owner/admin, delete never for the owner membership, self-removal and owner/admin otherwise); comparisons use strict in_array with enums (:22, :38). Mass assignment restricted through #[Fillable] on both models (app/Models/Entity.php:13, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12). No user input is handled, echoed, or trusted from the client in this change, and there are no secrets. No authorization or validation gap found.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no tests at all: no tests/ files, no *Test.php, no Pest test — only app/, database/, docs/ and CI files. The conventions require tests for every feature, including the DB-level single-owner constraint, cascade deletes, and each policy ability (allowed and denied paths); none of that is covered, and the added tests.yml cannot demonstrate them.

simplicity.evidence: Lean, idiomatic implementation: thin scopes instead of query helpers (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:52-77), no new service/repository layer, policy reuse instead of duplication (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:29-32 `return $this->update($user, $entity);`), and the required enum helper kept to one line (app/Models/UserRole.php:16-19). No speculative abstractions or copy-paste.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods and matching sibling style throughout (app/Models/*, app/Policies/*). Minor gap: `User::membershipFor()` is the only touched public method without a PHPDoc block (app/Models/User.php:53-56), and the generated-column expression is an inline SQL string with no comment (database/migrations/2026_10_29_033522_create_entity_memberships_table.php:19), though its intent is clear.

scope.evidence: Core code and docs all serve the task, but two CI files are unrelated and not requested: .github/workflows/tests.yml:1-11 adds a duplicate Pest PR job (the changelog already records a `bin/pf shell` test gate, CHANGELOG.md:27) with no PHP/Docker setup step, so it cannot succeed; .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1-3 is an empty file (blob e69de29) accidentally left in the change.

issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the models, migrations, factories or policies, violating the project's non-negotiable TDD convention and leaving the DB single-owner constraint and every policy denial path unverified.

This new CI workflow duplicates the existing Pest gate (already noted in CHANGELOG.md:27), is unrelated to the task, and only runs `./bin/pf shell php artisan test` with no PHP or Docker setup, so it will fail on a clean runner.
An empty file (empty blob e69de29) was added, which is an accidental artifact: it does nothing and, if a real deploy-dev workflow lives at this path, would shadow/replace it.
`membershipFor()` is the only public method added without a PHPDoc block, unlike the sibling relations in the same class.

The doc edit also drops `locale_default` from `entities`, which the task did not ask about; defensible as keeping the doc aligned with what was implemented, but broader than the `owner_membership_id` update requested.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership schema, models, enum, factories and both policies, and it matches the task contract including the portable stored-generated-column single-owner constraint; it also updates the schema docs and changelog. The blocking problem is that it ships with zero tests despite the project's mandatory TDD convention (tests 1), and it adds two unrelated CI files, one of which is empty and one broken. The feature code itself is correct and lean, so the change needs the test suite added and the stray CI files removed before merging.
